scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
